description:
Emit telemetry events around the registry, auth, and runner ops, and ship a pluggable tracing handler that prints one line per event to stderr when enabled.

## Events

Triplet pattern (`:start`, `:stop`, `:exception`) where the operation can fail or take time; single events otherwise.

- `[:octo_pi, :ai, :model_registry, :load]` start/stop — measurements: `system_time`, `duration`; metadata: `path`, `runner_count`, `model_count`, `error?`.
- `[:octo_pi, :ai, :model_registry, :resolve]` start/stop/exception — meta: `ref`, `runner`, `id`, `outcome` (`:cached | :looked_up | :not_found | :unsupported | :bad_ref`).
- `[:octo_pi, :ai, :auth, :resolve]` start/stop/exception — meta: `runner`, `strategy`, `source` (`:default | :auth_json`), `redacted: true` (never log the actual secret).
- `[:octo_pi, :ai, :runner, :lookup]` start/stop/exception — meta: `runner`, `id`, `outcome`.
- `[:octo_pi, :ai, :runner, :discover]` start/stop/exception — meta: `runner`, `model_count`.
- `[:octo_pi, :ai, :api, :request]` start/stop/exception — meta: `runner`, `api`, `model_id`, `endpoint`, `bytes_in`, `bytes_out`.
- `[:octo_pi, :ai, :api, :stream_chunk]` — meta: `runner`, `api`, `model_id`, `kind` (`:text | :thinking | :tool_call | :usage | :stop`), `bytes`.

## Tracing handler

`OctoPi.AI.Tracing` — `attach/0` and `detach/0`. When attached, formats each event as a single stderr line:

```
[trace] octo_pi.ai.runner.lookup runner=ollama id=qwen3:8b outcome=ok dur=412ms
```

- Auth events log `strategy` but never the value.
- Activated by `OCTO_PI_TRACE=1` env var (read at app start) or `config :octo_pi, :trace, true`. Both checked in `Application.start/2` and `attach/0` is called when either is truthy.
- Detached by default in `MIX_ENV=test` unless a test opts in.

## Tests

Use `:telemetry_test.attach_event_handlers/2` to assert events fire with expected metadata. No `Process.sleep` — synchronize via the `:stop` event.

## Out of scope

- Span IDs / W3C tracing context.
- Exporting to OTLP or any external sink.
- Per-request token-level events beyond `:stream_chunk`.
title: Telemetry + tracing for model registry / runners
